notes.title: YUMMY CHICKEN DRAGON RE:HATCHED
notes.content:
[h3]YUMMY CHICKEN DRAGON RE: HATCHED update is coming soon![/h3]

New levels and new horrors are added, and all in 3D!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/e4710f10c8d78435fec84c24d0472eefd697919d.png[/img]

Meet and talk to your family! Other Chicken Dragons inside the of the nest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/3efcc150806745446e664f11d0c7b1a67304108d.png[/img]

Things are what they seem in the world... something is happening outside of your nest...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/80a0c2fd056cde14aaf68a208920d8df9d48d29c.png[/img]



Watch as the story hatches into something far more... sinister.... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/8048bf2e0a809a3a84fcda6980883ef595908c3a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216346/1a302de67ebec106f809cc8f9fbdc22190aebcec.png[/img]

Once the update comes out there will be an option to go back to the original release of the game!
